name: Plain_English_Scheduling_Conditions
description: Removed all algebraic notation for the original scheduling rules (e.g., replacing explicit inequalities like $G_k + p1_k \le S_k$ with plain English constraint descriptions). The output codes are defined by referencing these plain English conditions by number. This forces the model to comprehend the scheduling semantics and derive the underlying mathematical bounds ($p1+p2>T$ and $\sum p > T$) itself, rather than pattern-matching against provided algebraic formulas.
